quests.title: Board Exam Warrior Quest
quests.description: Master board exam techniques and become confident in English literature!

story.introduction: The Board Exam Arena awaits! Prepare yourself with the skills and confidence needed to excel in your English examination.

steps.title: Character Analysis Mastery
steps.narrative: The Exam Master presents you with a character from 'First Flight'. Analyze their traits and motivations.

problem.question: Analyze the character of Lencho in 'A Letter to God'. What does his character represent?
problem.sample_answer: Lencho represents unwavering faith and simplicity. Despite facing natural disaster, his belief in God remains strong...
problem.explanation: Students should identify Lencho's faith, simplicity, and determination while connecting to the story's themes.
